title: Seth Rollins: betrayal and the championship heist
summary: Rollins abandons The Shield for The Authority. His rise culminates in cashing in during the WrestleMania main event against his former teammate and Brock Lesnar.

chapters.title: Rollins betrays The Shield
chapters.result: Rollins attacks Roman Reigns and Dean Ambrose with a chair.
chapters.context: The betrayal breaks apart the original trio.

chapters.title: The WrestleMania cash-in
chapters.result: Rollins cashes in during Lesnar vs. Reigns and pins Reigns to win the title.
chapters.context: The briefcase turns a singles main event into a triple threat.
